item.title: Show HN: Made a business license hub search tool
item.summary: Mostly built this as a way to learn how states distribute their data. A few are behind a unified API (Socrata) and many others have their own (daily file exports). The goal is try to get coverage for all 50 states. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49304167 Points: 2 # Comments: 1
